alignments.note: The adverbial accusative of harm is left unrendered; the ASV's *smart* carries the verb alone, as the margin's literal 'shall be sore broken' shows (read and set aside under rule 38).
Niphal finite verb with the subject pronoun realizing its person and number (rule 17), discontinuous around the relative clause under rule 25.
The written conjunction is recast as the relative the ASV wrote in its place, exactly as rule 17 gives such a relative to the connective.
Verb rendered by copula plus complement, headed on the complement (rule 44); the *for* is the English predicate's own valency (rule 33's closing paragraph).

The supplied preposition and its object answer to no morpheme, since the noun is not present (rule 33's closing sentences); the run stands together and does one office, so it is one unit under rule 2.
Anarthrous substantival participle takes the supplied *he that* (rule 46).
Object noun; the margin's literal 'those that strike hands' was read and set aside under rule 38.
Participial predicate with the construction-supplied copula (rule 20).
